note.ja: g9.81、[0,25]m、同じ放物線床、流量q4.42m²/s、下流h2m。h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g)の非射流根を別の二分法で求め、セル平均求積を比較します。100/200/400セルのPDE計算は定常参照から初期化してt2まで進め、SWASHESの静止状態からの過渡計算そのものは再現しません。
note.en: Use g9.81,[0,25]m, the parabolic bed, discharge q4.42m²/s and downstream depth2m. Independently bisect the subcritical root of h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g) and qualify cell quadrature. PDE runs on100/200/400cells start from the steady reference and advance to t2; they do not reproduce the original rest-to-steady transient.

note.ja: 静水の厳密釣合いは表現したセル地形に対する性質です。非零流量の定常解は厳密には保存されず、有限時刻の誤差を測ります。遷移流・跳水・摩擦・降雨・浸透・2次元流や完全離散エントロピー安定性は検証しません。 非負な静水圧再構成、共有HLL流束と左右の圧力補正で地形源項を離散化します。前進Euler、面Courant数.4。静水は反射壁。亜臨界流は上流で流量・下流で水深のみを指定し他変数を外挿します。floor・clip・retryはありません。 HLL更新を非負の水量packetに代数的に分解し、丸め後の同じ水量から移流運動量を作ります。微小水深閾値や事後修復は使いません。
note.en: Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope. Hydrostatic reconstruction, shared HLL flux and left/right pressure corrections discretize the bed source; forward Euler and face CFL .4. Lakes use reflecting walls. Moving subcritical boundaries impose upstream q and downstream h, extrapolating the other datum. No state floors, clipping or retries. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair.

note.en: Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope. One-dimensional frictionless Saint–Venant flow without rainfall. Distinguish the continuous topography from represented piecewise-constant bed means when checking hydrostatic balance. At a genuinely dry state h=q=0, define the advective momentum flux q²/h as0. 1D, g=9.81, L=25m, compact parabolic bed z=.2-.05(x-10)^2 on8<x<12. Lakes at surface .5/.1m use200 cells. Moving flow q=4.42m2/s, downstream h=2m uses100/200/400 cells to2s. Initialize the steady branch, not the published rest-to-steady transient.
